verdict.rationale: Unity's first-party AI Assistant lets users create assets, automate workflows, analyze performance and perform project actions through natural-language prompts. Its official MCP server also connects LLM agents such as Claude Code and Cursor to the Editor. However, the AI tools are documented as beta and ship in a pre-release package (2.20.0-pre.1), and every Assistant message is metered against Unity Credits, so coverage is limited rather than complete. Missing for 10: GA (non-beta) status, uncapped or unmetered natural-language operation, detailed docs on which editor operations prompts can drive, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
